svg.aria-label: How a question travels through Infera. When you upload: your files (PDF, Word, Markdown, CSV, text) are split into sentence-aware chunks, embedded with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and stored in a FAISS index. When you ask: the question is limited to files you may open, searched with FAISS plus a keyword rerank, and answered by Ollama, streamed, with citations. With no model running, Infera quotes the best passages instead.
